headline: Block Raises Full-Year Profit Outlook Driven by Cash App Growth
summary: Block raised its full-year profit outlook after reporting third-quarter growth propelled by strong performance in Cash App.
why: Block operates digital payment ecosystems including Square and Cash App, catering to merchants and consumer financial services.

impacts.name: Block
impacts.why: Upgraded financial forecasts and robust transaction volumes signal healthy underlying business expansion.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Upward revision of annual profit guidance and sustained user adoption of Cash App provided strong catalysts for investor optimism.
